newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CONSUMER CONFIDENCE ROSE IN SEPTEMBER - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CONSUMER CONFIDENCE ROSE IN SEPTEMBER - SF.

text.p: Finnish consumer confidence rose to 14.2 points in September from 12.9 points in August, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Thursday.
SF said this was a new record.

Consumer confidence is measured as the average of estimates on five variables: One's own finances in the past year and coming year, the Finnish economy in the past and the coming year, and how advantageous it is to buy durable goods.
In July, consumer confidence was 10.9 points.
